evidence.quote: Owned intelligence is not the same as rented intelligence.

observations.why: Contrasts owned vs. rented as distinct categories of value, enacting proportionality between possession and cost — a market-pricing framing of intelligence as asset.

evidence.quote: the perspective is the asset you keep.

observations.why: Classifies perspective as an asset retained against a commodity substrate, performing proportionality — what you keep vs. what is fungible.

mints.name: AssetCommodityBifurcation
mints.title: the perspective is the asset you keep
mints.frame: Is the expression partitioning something into a fungible commodity and a retained asset, and does that partition carry the relational move independent of what is being partitioned?
